x: Belgrave have been most fortunate in gaining the membership and support of Ron Severn who moved to Wimbledon from High Wycombe last year and has taken on the job of Assistant Secretary.
We thank him for all his efforts on our behalf. Ron Severn has taken up the mantle of Hon. Treasurer and it would be difficult to find someone better qualified.

Ron Severn reported on his first year as Hon Treasurer at the September AGM. Last year we had been warned that because the Hall would be out of action for 6 months during the rebuild and because we would need to start repaying the loans in 1985 there would be little likelihood of a profit.

Ron Severn our intrepid Treasurer does a super job balancing the accounts, but to perform the miracles demanded of him we need a lot more hard cash, so we earnestly ask you all to support to the utmost, any of the fund raising schemes that will be launched for the club's benefit.

Ron Severn rendered his report as Hon. Treasurer and explained many of the facets of the balance sheet which received and accepted with a vote of thanks to him and the two Auditors Ken Miller and Ron Conway.

Those appearing in the photographs amongst whose disguise can be seen through are:- Johnny Morris, Lionel Mann, Tootsie Gannon, Bob Bridges, Andy Paton, Ron Severn, Jackie Smiter, Geo Flanagan, Ben Cooper, Bill Laws, Olly Foote, Ross Bros, Matt Kinnane and Rin Tin Tin.
